about: A drop test: the part falls from the height, lands along 'down' and the floor pushes back. Frames start at first touch; position = vertex + translation[frame] + sum_k coeff[frame,k] * shape[k]. The elastic part is tiny, so scale it up to see it. Stress is the peak measure at each vertex, the g record is what an accelerometer at the watched spot reads, low pass filtered.
